title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Detention Day Rates for Dry-Class Equipment
content:
The daily detention amounts at dry-class rates, as quoted by each Demurrage and Detention Free Time product, are:

| Product | First slab | Second slab | Third slab | Fourth slab |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 65.00 | 110.00 | 165.00 | 230.00 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 52.00 | 88.00 | 132.00 | 184.00 |

All amounts are US dollars per container per chargeable detention day.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical inputs)

A dry unit with three detention days in the first slab and one in the second, under AHL Free Time Extension 3: three times 65.00 is 195.00, plus one day at 110.00, for a total of 305.00. Under AHL Contract Free Time 30 the same days total three times 52.00 plus 88.00, that is 244.00.
